mutants.reason: Legality for writes becomes AND instead of OR: aligned full-strobe writes only legal if pwrite=0 (never), reads with any strobe are illegal; legal requests get PSLVERR locally instead of a TL-UL request.
a_valid is set to 1 instead of cleared on a_accept, so a_valid is not dropped after the handshake and the request is repeated.
On local error PREADY is not raised, so the illegal transfer has no completion in the first Access cycle.
State condition inverted: responses in WAIT are no longer counted, and orphan d_valid in IDLE/REQ without accept would be counted.
PSLVERR is set to 1 in idle/non-completion cycles, so PSLVERR is high without PREADY.
Local-error branch condition inverted: illegal Setup gets no local error, while every other cycle loads pready/pslverr=1 and prdata=0.
w_resp_done uses OR, so orphan i_resp_valid outside BUSY, or BUSY with no response, produces a spurious PREADY completion.
Source check inverted: a response with the correct source is flagged as error and a wrong source is accepted without error.
w_resp_done is true only outside BUSY, so a real response in BUSY gives no APB completion (transfer hangs).
AND with the state term becomes OR: any d_valid with d_ready counts as a response, so orphans produce a completion.
Error OR becomes AND on the source term: a wrong source alone no longer raises an error.
a_valid is not set at the Setup edge load, so no TL-UL request is launched and the transfer hangs.
In WAIT the FSM leaves to IDLE when there is no response and stays when there is one, so the single-outstanding-request tracking breaks and the FSM returns to IDLE early.
The opcode flop resets to 1 instead of 0, so o_tlul_a_opcode is 3'b100 during reset.
Local error completes with PSLVERR=0 instead of 1, so the illegal transfer is not flagged.
Load condition inverted to a non-IDLE TL-UL state, so a Setup launch in IDLE never loads the payload or a_valid.
PREADY resets to 1, so o_apb_pready is high during reset.
Reset branch inverted: the reset values are applied in normal operation and not in reset.
w_local_err uses OR, so any Setup (even legal) or any illegal-looking inputs yield a local error/PSLVERR.
Strobe comparison inverted: full-strobe writes are rejected and partial-strobe writes are accepted as legal.
Load uses OR: the channel A flops load whenever the TL-UL FSM is IDLE, even without a launch, so a_valid is raised without a legal Setup.
OR changed to AND: a_accept and WAIT are never both true, so no response is ever counted.
d_ready is held at 0 after reset, so no response is ever accepted.
Reset branch inverted on the payload flops: they are cleared during operation and not reset (and load never happens), so opcode/address/data are wrong.
a_valid resets to 1, so o_tlul_a_valid is high during reset.
On response completion PREADY is not set, so the APB transfer never completes.
Accept is true outside REQ, so a_valid and FSM progress follow a_ready in the wrong states and the request is not accepted correctly in REQ.
PREADY stays 1 in non-completion cycles, so it is not a one-cycle pulse and is high outside an Access phase.
FSM goes to DONE when there is no local error and not launch, and stays IDLE on an illegal Setup; the FSM sequencing disagrees with PREADY.
Setup detection becomes (IDLE && psel) || !penable, so Setup is recognised without psel or during Access.
Accept uses OR: a_valid drops or a response counts when a_ready is high in any state or in REQ without a_ready, so handshake tracking is wrong.
a_valid is set when load is not asserted instead of on load, so the request is not launched at Setup and a_valid is raised spuriously.
d_ready resets to 1, so o_tlul_d_ready is high during reset.
PSLVERR resets to 1 without PREADY, so it is high during reset.
APB FSM reset branch inverted: it is forced to IDLE in operation and not reset, so transfers never reach BUSY/DONE correctly.
Setup detection becomes IDLE || (psel && !penable), so Setup is recognised in every IDLE cycle regardless of psel/penable.
